messages:
liz: Heads-up — we just published redwood-plugins v0.5.0 (community dev-day bundle). Includes new plugin scaffolding, lifecycle hooks, and one small breaking rename in plugin config. Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-plugins/releases/tag/v0.5.0 :tada:
open-source-bot: Release published: redwood-plugins v0.5.0 by @liz — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-plugins/releases/tag/v0.5.0 (auto)
sam: 🔥 nice. quick q — what exactly changed in the config?
liz: Short version: plugin.yml -> plugin.config.yml and the key `entry` is renamed to `main`. We added a tiny migration script in the repo under scripts/. Also added a compatibility note for older redwoodctl.
liz: Example migration snippet:
```bash
# scripts/migrate-config.sh
jq '., ."plugin.config.yml" = ."plugin.yml" | .main = .entry | del(.entry)' plugin.yml > plugin.config.yml
```
maria: Awesome — do we have a maintainers list in the repo? I can run office hours this week for plugin maintainers (Wed 10am PT) if folks want to join.
devrel: :thumbsup: I'll add the office hours to the community calendar and draft a short blurb for the newsletter and tweet thread.
chris: Any runtime/backwards-compat concerns? Do we need to bump adapter version for redwoodctl or dedicated runtime images?
liz: redwoodctl compatibility: no API changes, but redwoodctl will read both plugin.yml and plugin.config.yml for a month; we'll ship a warning log for the old key. Dedicated runtime: if you're running images built before 2025-12, run `redwoodctl plugins refresh` after upgrading plugins to avoid stale cached metadata. We'll include that in the release notes.
sam: Can we add a CI lint that fails when plugin.yml contains `entry`? I can open a PR later today.
open-source-bot: New issue created: #342 "add migration lint for plugin config" by @sam — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-plugins/issues/342
liz: Thanks — tagging maintainers for visibility: @maria @sam @chris. We'll do a staged announce: community slack + newsletter today, then cross-post to forum.
maria: I'll update the release notes page with an explicit migration section and add a short screencast to the docs.
chris: Great. congrats everyone on the release — exciting to see the scaffolder improvements land.
liz: Thanks team. If you run into anything odd while migrating, ping me in #devex and we'll triage. :rocket:
